intro_html: A proper bed needn't start at £150. Dog beds under £100, from £69, each with at least one size under £100 and the 100-night sleep trial.
description_html:
You don't need to spend a fortune to get your dog off a cold floor. But a bed that's flat by spring isn't the cheaper option; you just buy it more often. These dog beds under £100 all have at least one size below £100, starting at £69. The real differences between them are what's inside and how they're shaped.

One thing to know first: some beds here also come in larger sizes that cost more than £100. The price for each size is on the product page, so check the one you need.

Dog beds under £100, by what's inside

  • If they are heavy or slowing down, choose memory foam, which keeps its shape under weight. Chatsworth is our lowest-priced memory foam bed: crumb memory foam, bolster walls and a non-slip base, £69 to £99 across three sizes. Buttermere is a 110 × 85cm memory foam mattress, 10cm deep, at £99. Haweswater's Medium is a memory foam dog sofa at £99. All three carry a 5-year no-flatten guarantee on the foam core.
  • If they rest a chin on a firm edge: Langdale's Medium, 94 × 72cm at £99, has a foam base and a raised rim made from foam rather than loose filling.
  • If they like to sink in, choose soft fill, cosy rather than firm. Troutbeck is a 110 × 75cm plush bolster bed at £69. Blea Tarn is a cream bouclé nest from £69.
  • If they run hot or lie on cold tiles, choose no filling at all: the elevated mesh beds, Windermere from £89 and Bassenthwaite from £99, lift them clear of the floor and rinse clean.

How to choose at this price

Decide by how they sleep, then by what they need underneath. Fibre packs down under weight, so a heavy dog, or one who's slowing down, will get more from foam; if they are stiff or sore, keep talking to your vet too, because a bed is comfort, not treatment.

Then size, in centimetres rather than labels. A Medium on one bed can be bigger than a Large on another: Ullswater's Medium is 67 × 95cm, while Chatsworth's Large is 70 × 55cm. The size guide shows how to measure.

What you still get under £100

Spending less shouldn't mean taking more of a chance. Every bed here comes with the 100-night sleep trial: if it isn't right within 100 nights, we arrange free UK mainland collection and a full refund. One trial per household; damage and other exclusions apply. Free standard UK delivery on orders over £40, which every bed here clears.

Questions about dog beds under £100

Can I get a memory foam dog bed for under £100?

Yes. Chatsworth (from £69), Buttermere (£99) and Haweswater's Medium (£99) are memory foam. Langdale's Medium (£99) is foam with a foam rim. For the full range, see memory foam dog beds.

What's the lowest-priced large dog bed here?

Troutbeck: £69 for 110 × 75cm, the lowest price in this collection for a bed that size, with a deep-filled bolster all the way round. It's soft-filled rather than foam, so for firmer support look at Buttermere. More big beds are in large dog beds.

Why do some beds show prices over £100?

The collection includes any bed with a size under £100. Larger sizes of the same bed can cost more, and each size's price is shown on the product page.

Want a quick answer? The Bed Finder matches one bed to how they sleep.
